body.x: OZOMETA Co., Ltd. (CEO Changgyu Kim) announced its participation in CES 2025 in the K-Startup Pavilion from January 7 to 10 in Las Vegas.

The company specializes in digital twin technology and automated 3D modeling for the urban development and construction industries. Its core innovations include automated 3D design, precise material quantity calculation, and construction simulation integrated with big data for real-time visualization and management.

OZOMETA's 3D modeling automation addresses the challenges of transitioning from 2D to 3D workflows in construction by standardizing and automating the design of external structures and internal elements such as rebar and MEP piping. The platform achieves over 95% accuracy in material quantity calculations, enabling precise estimations. Additionally, integrated with DMS big data, the construction simulation and visualization technology allow users to respond to site changes in real-time by selecting pre-defined options.

The company has completed POCs (proof of concept) for projects such as cultural centers and welfare facilities for the hearing impaired in Incheon, South Korea. It is collaborating on a community facility construction project organized by the Seo-gu District Office in Incheon. Looking ahead, OZOMETA plans to expand its services to include new constructions and retrofit existing buildings, ultimately transitioning into a platform-driven business model.

At CES 2025, OZOMETA will introduce its automated 3D modeling technology, which generates precise 3D models for concrete, rebar, and MEP systems. The technology leverages architectural codes, 2D design information, and accumulated data to significantly reduce modeling time, providing a faster and more efficient alternative to traditional methods.

The construction-integrated 3D modeling further supports real-time adjustments to meet on-site requirements and project changes. This adaptability leads to reduced design costs, shorter construction timelines, and overall savings in construction expenditures, highlighting the platform's value proposition for the global construction market.

OZOMETA’s innovative approach to digital twin technology and construction automation positions it as a pioneer in modernizing the construction industry. It aims to improve efficiency and reduce costs while ensuring precision and adaptability.
